Here's your multiple-choice quiz:

What is a common method used to measure the difference between text generated by a language model and a reference text?

A) Fluency score
B) Word Error Rate (WER)
C) Coherence index
D) Relevance ratio

Correct answer: B) Word Error Rate (WER)
